He climbed the stairs again, trimmed the wick, polished the lens until it blazed, and for the first time felt the dark water was listening.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于放低了喧嚣。路灯在空荡的街口亮着，像一排守夜人，把橘黄的光铺在潮湿的柏油路上。早点铺的蒸汽刚刚升起，环卫工人的扫帚声沙沙作响，远处偶尔驶过一辆夜班公交，车窗里睡着疲惫的人。高楼大多沉默，只有零星几扇窗还亮着，藏着未眠的故事。风带着凉意穿过巷子，天边泛起一线微蓝，新的一天正悄悄醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each time you repeat it, the problem gets a little smaller, until you reach the tiniest one that is so easy you can just answer it. That is called the base case.\n- Then you pass answers back up the chain, so the biggest job gets finished by all the little ones, like a line of dominoes falling back to the start."}
